newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM to widen daily limit for palladium futures.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM to widen daily limit for palladium futures.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said it would widen the daily price limit for palladium futures from the current 22 yen per gram to 33 yen per gram, effective from March 3.
The move was aimed at cooling down overheated trade in palladium futures in recent months, a TOCOM spokesman said.

On Friday, all months of TOCOM palladium futures surged by their 22 yen per gram daily limits, as speculative money flowed into the market because of Russian supply fears. -- Tokyo Commodity Desk +81-3-3432-7431
